from pathlib import Path
import pytest


def first_readable(names: list[str]) -> str:
    """Return the text of the first readable file in 'notes' matching a name.

    Names come from untrusted requests. Only files inside the 'notes' directory
    (relative to the current working directory) may be read, including files
    in subdirectories. Returns an empty string if no file can be read or if
    path traversal outside 'notes' is attempted.
    """
    notes_dir = Path("notes").resolve()
    if not notes_dir.is_dir():
        return ""

    for name in names:
        try:
            target = (notes_dir / name).resolve()
            if not target.is_relative_to(notes_dir) or target == notes_dir:
                continue
            if not target.is_file():
                continue
            return target.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
        except (OSError, UnicodeDecodeError, ValueError):
            continue

    return ""


def test_first_readable_empty_list() -> None:
    assert first_readable([]) == ""


def test_first_readable_single_file(
    tmp_path: Path, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch
) -> None:
    monkeypatch.chdir(tmp_path)
    notes_dir = tmp_path / "notes"
    notes_dir.mkdir()
    (notes_dir / "a.txt").write_text("hello", encoding="utf-8")

    assert first_readable(["a.txt"]) == "hello"


def test_first_readable_skips_missing_to_find_valid(
    tmp_path: Path, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch
) -> None:
    monkeypatch.chdir(tmp_path)
    notes_dir = tmp_path / "notes"
    notes_dir.mkdir()
    (notes_dir / "second.txt").write_text("found me", encoding="utf-8")

    assert first_readable(["missing.txt", "second.txt"]) == "found me"


def test_first_readable_all_missing(
    tmp_path: Path, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch
) -> None:
    monkeypatch.chdir(tmp_path)
    notes_dir = tmp_path / "notes"
    notes_dir.mkdir()

    assert first_readable(["missing1.txt", "missing2.txt"]) == ""


def test_first_readable_subdirectory(
    tmp_path: Path, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch
) -> None:
    monkeypatch.chdir(tmp_path)
    sub_dir = tmp_path / "notes" / "sub"
    sub_dir.mkdir(parents=True)
    (sub_dir / "b.txt").write_text("nested content", encoding="utf-8")

    assert first_readable(["sub/b.txt"]) == "nested content"


def test_first_readable_prevents_directory_traversal(
    tmp_path: Path, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch
) -> None:
    monkeypatch.chdir(tmp_path)
    notes_dir = tmp_path / "notes"
    notes_dir.mkdir()
    (notes_dir / "good.txt").write_text("safe", encoding="utf-8")

    outside_file = tmp_path / "secret.txt"
    outside_file.write_text("secret", encoding="utf-8")

    # Relative traversal
    assert first_readable(["../secret.txt"]) == ""
    assert first_readable(["../secret.txt", "good.txt"]) == "safe"

    # Absolute path traversal
    assert first_readable([str(outside_file.resolve())]) == ""

    # Complex traversal with redundant parts
    assert first_readable(["sub/../../secret.txt"]) == ""


def test_first_readable_skips_directories(
    tmp_path: Path, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch
) -> None:
    monkeypatch.chdir(tmp_path)
    sub_dir = tmp_path / "notes" / "sub"
    sub_dir.mkdir(parents=True)
    (tmp_path / "notes" / "file.txt").write_text("regular file", encoding="utf-8")

    assert first_readable(["sub", "file.txt"]) == "regular file"


def test_first_readable_symlink_escape_prevented(
    tmp_path: Path, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch
) -> None:
    monkeypatch.chdir(tmp_path)
    notes_dir = tmp_path / "notes"
    notes_dir.mkdir()

    outside_file = tmp_path / "outside.txt"
    outside_file.write_text("outside data", encoding="utf-8")

    symlink_file = notes_dir / "leak.txt"
    try:
        symlink_file.symlink_to(outside_file)
    except (OSError, NotImplementedError):
        pytest.skip("Symlinks not supported on this platform")

    assert first_readable(["leak.txt"]) == ""
